facts.fact: 两座坟：母亲坟围铁笼（木桩钉肋防复活——「despite my mother's wishes」）、Oren 坟不设防；柳树垂泣相伴
facts.anchor: The stake pinning her ribs to the earth put a stop to that.

facts.fact: 落日下三连 wish；手按坟土想再分一次日落——「God be damned, I can hear her, and only her.」渎神二度
facts.anchor: I wish, I wish, I wish.

facts.fact: 摇篮曲追忆：母亲的歌「strange and awful words...Her voice was ever sharp, each word a shallow cut」——「despite everything, a part of me yearned for her embrace...Is that not something within us all? Something so desperately human」
Anne 陪跪（裙湿也陪）——「She cannot hear you beneath the earth」「I am not so sure. I hear her, in my dreams still. She sings to me, Anne. She will not let me go.」
facts.anchor: I hear her, in my dreams still.

facts.fact: Anne 孕肚与哀容并存：「weighing the edges of her smile so it never blooms quite as full」；「She smells of lilies, of the garden she plants in spring.」
facts.anchor: Her belly is heavy, filled with new life,

facts.fact: Anne 问 Oren 的鬼（Blackwood Hall 静、不居死者）——「I cannot quite tell if it brings me peace that I am not haunted by Oren. But I miss him. There will never be a darkened corner I will not search for him in.」
facts.anchor: There will never be a darkened corner I will not search for him in.

facts.fact: 秋撕小镇成「blistered wound」；「In the absence of terror, the emptiness still will not fill, and will never scar over. It is a canker sore, not a bruise.」——疤的否定
facts.anchor: It is a canker sore, not a bruise.

facts.fact: 「Folkehaven Manor is my home, crooked and broken and filled with echoes. But I take Anne’s hand again, and allow her to lead me away.」——全书第一次允许被带离
facts.anchor: I take Anne’s hand again, and allow her to lead me away.
